question: In which year did Saina Nehwal win the Olympic bronze medal in the individual women's Badminton competition?
solution:
Correct Answer __**2012**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saina Nehwal** won the **Olympic bronze medal** in the** individual women's badminton competition** in the year **2012.**
 
• She achieved this milestone at the **2012 Summer Olympics held in London, United Kingdom.**
 
• Saina Nehwal became the first Indian badminton player to win an **Olympic medal **in the **women's singles category.**
 
• Saina Nehwal is a female Indian singles badminton player.
 
• A former world no. 1, she has won over 24 international titles, including eleven titles in the Superseries.
 
• While she reached the 2nd world ranking in 2009, it was only in 2015 that she was able to cross the No. 1 world ranking.
 
• Nehwal is the first Indian to win two Commonwealth Games singles gold medals (2010 and 2018).
 
• In 2016, Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award, was awarded to her by the Government of India.
